execution: Actual async physical motion and acquisition during screen recording; not prepared playback or a reused successful command trajectory.

test_validation.reason: All41 frozen runtime/configuration files are byte-identical to the already tested source.

selection: One complete normalized Gaussian/Bingham-mixture J gradient per request, finite0.5s position reference held until next plan; no horizon rollout. Continuous coordinator execution-K damping and source-consistent actual ledger remain.

video.video_alignment_note: Process-launch-to-service timing is provenance, not an exact first-frame optical timestamp; the actual video contains the initial stopped scene and the FINISHED90s scene.

representative_frame_review.scope: Manual read-only review of actual decoded frames. Backend post-drain correctness is verified separately and is not inferred from a video frame.

single_update_full_J.scope: Every single-update full gradient/trial/normalizer/mixture term and exact position constraint independently reconstructed, including the strict-interior cone and actual source/candidate identity. No future IK rollout.

position_hold_execution.scope: One selected endpoint, original source-clock interpolation and finite endpoint hold after the selected duration, unscaled position tracking and ordinary actuator bounds independently recomputed. No forced zero request at the nominal end, no future rollout, and no call to the runtime reference helper or IK/inference.

execution_K.scope: 20 Hz filter recurrence independently recomputed; unchanged full estimated records/density/proposals; request samples frozen with IK, same epoch actual ledger, deterministic auxiliary mechanics, and actual historical next-prior/catchup replay. Filter signal is not a posterior.

K_representative.scope: recorded full continuous density and score restored, every bounded representative step checked, unchanged estimated K traced separately from the applied K into IK and actual command ledger; no true stiffness input

visible_hold_policy.scope: actual adopted raw-preview index and timestamp, same fused goal and committed IK source, exact bounded local command intervals, stopped post-stop-observation resume; no physical truth input

absolute_pose_accuracy.covariance_width_definition: 3*sqrt(trace(P)), a diagnostic Euclidean width; anisotropic Gaussian proxy coverage uses support-aware Mahalanobis chi-square95

limitations: Video encoding fps, camera acquisition fps, physical motion Hz and accepted estimator/IK Hz describe different processes; they must not be equated.
Each existing1840x1200 RViz view is preserved. The two existing internal camera views/zoom levels are different; identical capture dimensions do not imply identical RViz viewpoints.
Recording includes pre-roll and a short FINISHED hold around90 seconds of physical motion. Estimator drain may extend beyond the end of the physical motion and is recorded separately.

World success means the physical tip entered the unchanged6mm tolerance at some time without forbidden collision across the trajectory. It does not mean the terminal tip remains inside, or that oscillation is absent.
Absolute body and target pose accuracy, uncertainty calibration and true stiffness identification are not established by relative reaching.

Only latest selected capture frames are fused; all raw acquisitions and selections are archived. The observed modes/cross covariances and the same candidate laws are independently verified on actual wire.
These asynchronous90-second runs have their own command/observation histories; numerical differences from60-second predecessors are not a controlled single-cause performance comparison.
Large raw estimation, image and wire records are retained at the listed audit-host paths and bound by hashes. They are not all bundled in this video delivery directory.

excluded_pre_restart_recording.reason: The user explicitly required restarting RViz before recording. The initial90s captures preceded that restart and are historical only, not the delivered videos.
